# Calvin University Admissions

> > Calvin University admissions portal connecting prospective students with campus visits, recruitment events, and personalized guidance in Grand Rapids, Michigan.

This admissions site helps prospective undergraduate and international students explore Calvin University through virtual chats, campus tours, college fairs, and recruitment visits across the United States. The portal provides visit scheduling, event calendars, and resources for both domestic and international applicants.

## Key Topics

- Calvin University
- Grand Rapids, Michigan
- Campus visits
- International students
- Prospective students
- College fairs
- High school visits
- Recruitment events
- Visit Grant program
- Discovery Day
- Virtual events
- Admissions counselors
- Transfer students
- College & Career Conference

## Campus Visits & Tours

- [Visit | Calvin University](https://admissions.calvin.edu/portal/visit): Campus visit options including Discovery Day and Summer Visit Day tours

## International Student Resources

- [International Student Chats | Calvin University](https://admissions.calvin.edu/portal/international-student-chat): Virtual chat events for international prospective students in Grand Rapids

## Recruitment Events & College Fairs

- [Calvin University - Calvin is coming to a location near you!](https://admissions.calvin.edu/portal/trips): Calvin University recruitment visit schedule and college fair locations
